verdict.rationale: Statsig ships Dynamic Configs as a first-party feature alongside boolean feature gates. The HTTP API retrieves dynamic config values, the CLI and target apps manage them, and A/B/n experiments serve each group a different variant. However, no evidence shows which value types a config can hold (strings, numbers, JSON), and feature gates themselves return only pass/fail. missing for 10: documentation of typed config values (string/number/JSON payloads), documentation of multivariate flag variants outside experiments, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans
